fichas.title: Accessible building requirements
fichas.summary: The page reproduces Model Building Regulations requirements for accessible housing and public buildings. It specifies accessible routes, entrance and ramp dimensions, landings, stairs, corridors, and wheelchair-accessible toilet provision.
uses: Provide accessible flats and rooms for wheelchair users
Enable disabled people, older people, and people with small children to access and use public buildings without outside help

dimensions.label: Clear entrance opening width, minimum
dimensions.context: Accessible entrance without steps
dimensions.ocr_raw: clear opening width of at least 0.90 m without steps

dimensions.label: Maximum ramp slope
dimensions.context: Accessible ramps
dimensions.ocr_raw: Ramps may not have a slope of more than 6%

dimensions.label: Ramp width, minimum
dimensions.context: Accessible ramps
dimensions.ocr_raw: must be at least 1.20 m wide

dimensions.label: Maximum interval between intermediate ramp landings
dimensions.context: Intermediate landings along a ramp

dimensions.label: Ramp landing length, minimum
dimensions.context: Landings at ramp starts, ends, and intermediate points
dimensions.ocr_raw: The landings must have a length of at least 1.50 m

dimensions.label: Corridor and entrance hall width, minimum
dimensions.context: Corridors and entrance halls
dimensions.ocr_raw: Corridors and entrance halls must be at least 1.50 m wide

fichas.title: Accessible housing plans and guideline flat areas
fichas.summary: Illustrated flat plans show conversion examples and flats of different sizes. A table gives guideline room and living-area sizes for flats with one wheelchair user, by household size; the page also depicts a visually impaired child’s flat conversion.
uses: Plan or adapt flats for occupants with disabilities, including wheelchair users and a visually impaired child
Use the tabulated room areas as flat-planning guidelines
